variables.description: User- or company-specific values (tenant, workspace, login, user ID) kept out of the shared Blink. Each is filled from the user's private Blink (section variables). A server URL or requested origin may hold {name} as a whole host label in front of a fixed registrable domain; a parameter or top-level body field marks its value source with x-blink-variable.
